items: Slots can push as the farm's one signed GitHub identity (<FARMSLOT_HOME>/git-identity.json); slot check verifies signing
Slots whose repo cannot check out the default branch are flagged with the reason and skipped by dispatch
Published runs free their slot when they end, and blocked runs resume by themselves when the worker continues
Workers on remote nodes reach the gateway that dispatched them, and Codex reviews launch unattended
An explicitly chosen slot that is still releasing waits up to 5 minutes instead of failing as busy
